references.text: Prohibition against leaving any of the Passover lamb until morning, paralleling the prohibition against leaving fat until the next morning
Nearly identical verse repeating the prohibition against offering blood together with leavened bread and against leaving the Passover sacrifice until morning
Prohibition against using yeast in offerings to the Lord, expanding on the ban against offering with chametz
Requirement that meat from the thank offering be eaten on the same day and not left until morning
Passover legislation forbidding yeast in connection with the Passover sacrifice and requiring that the meat not be left until the next morning
Regulations concerning the fat belonging to the Lord, which must not be eaten but offered
Rules for the thank offering to be eaten on the same day without leaving anything until morning
Shared principles that holy meat must not remain until the next morning, even though the context (inauguration versus festival) differs.
Direct Deuteronomic repetition confirming Passover rules regarding yeast and time limits for sacrificial meat.
